categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet database structures and loading logic in src/wallet/walletdb.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: This PR records metadata in the wallet database to track client capabilities across opens and decryptions, laying necessary groundwork for future backwards-compatible wallet upgrades. As noted in the description, without recording feature bitflags, future versions cannot reliably detect if an upgraded wallet was modified by an older release without costly full-wallet rescans.
